items.title: Hegseth's religious rhetoric and Pentagon prayers rile some Americans
items.description: The ABC visits US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's church, whose leaders challenge the legitimacy of democracy and key principles in the US constitution.

items.title: Why the oil crisis is about to worsen amid the ceasefire that wasn't
items.description: The official pledges of the last few days may have placated markets at first, but they have become little more than bargaining chips ahead of this weekend's negotiations between the US and Iran.

items.title: The last-minute diplomacy that brought Trump back from the brink
items.description: For a few volatile hours, the war in the Middle East appeared to be tipping past the point of no return — until a last-minute push of diplomacy pulled it back.

items.title: Second midwife charged over baby's death following failed homebirth
items.description: Jordan Michaela Holland is the second midwife charged with manslaughter over the death of a baby after a failed homebirth in Newcastle.

items.title: Friends, family thank the community for helping to find missing woman
items.description: The family and friends of a woman who was missing for a week in south-western Victoria have thanked the community after she was found safe and well.

items.title: 'Never friends': Melania Trump criticises Epstein 'lies' in unusual address
items.description: In an unusual White House address, Melania Trump denies having a friendship with Jeffrey Epstein and complains about "mean-spirited" attempts to smear her.

items.title: Peter Dutton appointed to Queensland investment board
items.description: Mr Dutton's has kept a low public profile since he led the Coalition to defeat at the 2025 federal election, and also lost his seat of Dickson.

items.title: High Court urged to toss reduced sentence for Emma Lovell killer
items.description: Lawyers for the Queensland government have travelled to Canberra to urge the High Court to toss out a reduced sentence for a teen jailed for killing Emma Lovell in 2022.

items.title: Deep in a Ugandan forest, chimpanzees wage a lethal 'civil war'
items.description: A decades-long study reveals hundreds of chimpanzees waging a violent and deadly conflict against their former friends in their remote forest home.

items.title: This couple has a fixed price contract to build their home — it's just gone up $120,000
items.description: Contractors, business owners and economists warn that thousands of construction industry businesses could go bust as a result of supply chain disruptions caused by the Iran War, unless the government intervenes.

items.title: Long queues at EV chargers highlight gaps in charging infrastructure
items.description: Sales of electric vehicles have surged, but NSW government mapping shows regional areas are still lacking EV charging stations.

items.title: Snoozing seal blocks road in popular coastal spot
items.description: Locals say they are not surprised the seal, described as a regular visitor, decided to stop for a snooze on the roadway.

items.title: Racism erupts after Melbourne announces Little India plans
items.description: Social media posts about the announcement of a Little India precinct in Melbourne are flooded with racist comments, leaving some Indians with mixed feelings about the plan.

items.title: Panther faces one-match ban for high shot that broke Bulldog's jaw
items.description: Penrith centre Casey McLean is facing a one-week suspension for a high shot that left Canterbury prop Max King with a broken jaw.

items.title: Sean 'Diddy' Combs's four-year prison sentence questioned in appeals court
items.description: Sean "Diddy" Combs's lawyers argue his four-year prison term for prostitution-related charges is too harsh.

items.title: Live: ASX 200 and Aussie dollar down, Brent crude oil up
items.description: The Australian market is set for a disappointing end to the trading week, finding itself in negative territory, despite US stocks rising overnight. Follow the day's events and insights as they happen with our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Euphoria ushered in a new generation of A-listers. Now, it's finally back
items.description: Sam Levinson's controversial teen series has had to overcome four years of actor deaths, character departures and on-set tension to make it to season three.

items.title: Rain easing for AFL Gather Round as negotiations for event's future continue
items.description: The Bureau of Meteorology says wet weather conditions will improve for AFL Gather Round matches as the weekend progresses, as the premier shares his ongoing bid to keep the event in South Australia.

items.title: Queensland state MP Jimmy Sullivan found dead
items.description: Police were called to an address in the northern Brisbane suburb of Stafford last night where a man's body was found. Mr Sullivan was elected to parliament in 2020 and re-elected in 2024.

items.title: Life sentence for Sunshine Coast man who stabbed victim with his own knife
items.description: Following a trial held in Brisbane, a jury deliberated for almost two days before returning its verdict.

items.title: Family 'empty' and 'shocked' after surfer's death over $50 dispute
items.description: Guy Haymes was left in a vegetative state after an assault during a dispute over $50 in February, 2024.

items.title: Warning system made WA community feel 'unsafe' during ex-Cyclone Narelle
items.description: Residents in the Pilbara raise concerns over the state's warning system for cyclones following ex-Tropical Cyclone Narelle last month.

items.title: 'People assume we're not real': MPs open up about mental health challenges
items.description: A national study has found 70 per cent of politicians feel their job is affecting their mental health. The ABC spoke to three Tasmanian MPs, including the state's premier, about their experiences.

items.title: Super members blindsided by change in fund terms and conditions
items.description: A superannuation investment option spruiked as offering "choice and flexibility" has been shut down without proper notification, leaving members less than two months to sell all their assets.

items.title: Sexual misconduct now publicly listed on 100 health practitioners' records
items.description: More than 100 past and current practitioners have had findings of sexual misconduct added to their public-facing records under new reforms to promote transparency.
